digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent clone and autodeploy bootstrap
propositions: The EBS-backed external volume's persistent tickets clone is not refreshed on redeploy because the generated entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, preserving divergent history.

The ensure-tickets script must invoke convergence outside the PAT block to handle cases where REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, and must fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets to advance the remote-tracking ref.
Pre-epoch local clones must adopt the fetched epoch-bearing remote commit only when the pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of the readable prior remote tip, proving no local-only commits exist.
Failed or credentialless fetches must exit best-effort success, preserve the exact local tip, emit operator-readable warnings, and never undo an already-cast vote.
Changes to infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh must be detected by the deploy classifier and trigger review-bot redeployment via autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS.
